port_instructions: patch_xbox_actions_noop (1.2.8 branch): write byte 0x21 ('!') over the first character of two .rdata strings after checking they are 0x62 ('b'): image+0x00D99E28 ("button.signin", expected bytes 62 75 74 74 6f 6e 2e 73...) and image+0x00DA345C ("button.xbl_signin"). Use VirtualProtect(PAGE_READWRITE) and restore; no execute permission, no FlushInstructionCache. Do it before the game constructs any ScreenController (i.e. in Win32Bootstrap, same place as on x86). Keep the 'return FALSE + log' behaviour on mismatch.

There is exactly one copy of each string; five registration sites (ItemDetail/StoreBase for button.signin, StartMenu/XblFirstLaunch/XblOptionalSignin for button.xbl_signin) all read that single copy, so no further string or lambda patches are needed (matches x86). Do not touch 'button.save_to_xbl', 'menu_xbox_signin_button' or 'xbox_signin' (x86 does not).

install_xbox_tcui_noops_128: ARM cell order is DIFFERENT. Assign by import name: *(void**)(image+0x015121FC) = win32_show_profile_card_noop (HRESULT, args HSTRING/callback/context ignored, return E_NOTIMPL=0x80004001); *(void**)(image+0x01512200) = win32_process_pending_game_ui_noop (return S_OK); *(void**)(image+0x01512208) = win32_show_profile_card_for_user_noop (return E_NOTIMPL); leave image+0x01512204 (null terminator) untouched. One VirtualProtect(image+0x015121FC, 16, PAGE_READWRITE) as on x86. Drop WINAPI/stdcall annotations; function pointers are Thumb (bit0 set) automatically. The only caller is wrapper 0xA3E014, which skips ProcessPendingGameUI/wait when the Show* call returns E_NOTIMPL, exactly like x86.

patch_chat_textbox_compat: delete/skip. It is 1.1.5-only on x86 (early return for 1.2.8) and the ARM 1.2.8 exe contains no XAML classes (no 'Windows.UI.Xaml*' or TextBox strings, UTF-16 or ASCII), so there is nothing to guard. Keep supplying the fake Windows.UI.Text.Core.CoreTextServicesManager/CoreTextEditContext factory (used by HIDController ctor via fn 0x628248) as on x86 1.2.8.

install_exception_trace: patch the IAT cell image+0x00C374E4 (VCRUNTIME140_APP!_CxxThrowException) with the logging hook, saving the original (Thumb) pointer. Signature void(void* exception /*r0*/, const void* throwInfo /*r1*/), noreturn. Convert logged frame addresses to RVAs by subtracting image base and clearing bit 0. dump_115_stdio_state is not relevant to 1.2.8. install_crash_trace/win32_vectored_exception must be rewritten for the ARM32 CONTEXT (Pc/Sp/Lr/R0-R12) and must not walk an EBP chain.

Every code-bytes patch on the x86 1.2.8 path that remains necessary (3 mouse lambdas, pickFile, ClientInstance vtable slot 3, zip getAsset cells) should be done by overwriting vtable/data cells (see catalog_mouse_hooks, catalog_pickfile_jump, catalog_vtable_cells); write_relative_jump (E9 + NOPs) and the 10-byte x86 expected-byte arrays must be removed. If a code patch is unavoidable use the 8-byte Thumb trampoline DF F8 00 F0 + (target|1) at a 4-aligned entry, then FlushInstructionCache.
Windows-7-only patches (DiscardView 0xC3 patch, DXGI Device3 IID downgrade, Device2 QI downgrade) are never executed on ARM; do not port them.
open_questions: The ShowProfileCard chain (0xA3CC30 -> 0xA3C580 -> 0xA3E014) has no inbound references in the image; the three TCUI no-ops are therefore defensive. If a runtime log ever shows 'Xbox profile-card request ignored by Win32 host' on ARM, find the dynamic caller (maybe via a std::function stored as a raw pointer built at runtime).

AppPlatform_Winrt::showKeyboard/hideKeyboard (vf11/vf12, lambdas 0x586CC4/0x586F8C) call InputPane::GetForCurrentView, which fails in a plain HWND process. x86 1.2.8 installs no hook and apparently survives because the CoreDispatcher delegate Invoke translates the thrown exception to an HRESULT; this was not proven on ARM (delegate wrapper not disassembled). If the ARM host crashes when a chat/text box gets focus, replace vtable cells 0x013695D0/0x013695D4 (slots 11/12 of AppPlatform_Winrt 0x013695A4) with host stubs that only maintain the keyboard-visible byte (this+9) and text_input_active.

button.save_to_xbl and the other non-patched callers of ScreenController::xblSignIn (0x21B848; 11 of its 16 callers are not covered by the string patch) remain live on both x86 and ARM; if the ARM host (WinRT sign-in classes absent) crashes when they are used, hook 0x21B848 (bytes 2d e9 b0 48 0d f1 0c 0b) or rename 'button.save_to_xbl' (0xD95E5C) as optional hardening.

ViewRequest return value semantics (0 vs 8) are only partially confirmed (0x2d33b4 returns 8 on its early-out; sign-in lambdas return 0 after starting the sign-in). Only relevant for the optional lambda-body fallback.

The XblOptionalSigninScreenController handler lambda (registered at 0x2D646C through a stack std::function built by 0x2D6B38, sign-in call from 0x2D64CC) was not isolated; irrelevant while the string patch is used.
The ARM image size gate (SizeOfImage 0x1730000 stock) and how the ARM exe will be patched to import win32craft.dll are outside this area (winmain/pe).
